events.title: Tropical precarity
events.summary: Explore the intersections of performance, visual art, gender expression, and cultural resistance in Puerto Rico through a special performance and panel discussion featuring acclaimed artists Freddie Mercado Velázquez and Mickey Negrón.

evidence.description: The Latina/o Studies and the Contemporary Performance in Puerto Rico Working Group, in partnership with the Department of American Culture, invites you to Tropical Precarity: Drag and Visual Arts in Puerto Rico, a special performance and panel discussion. This event features an in-depth conversation with acclaimed Puerto Rican artists Freddie Mercado Velázquez and Mickey Negrón, exploring the intersections of performance, visual art, gender expression, and cultural resistance.

events.title: Saturday Morning Physics | The Physics of Art and the Art of Physics
events.summary: Explore the intersection of physics and art in this hybrid lecture. Discover how scientific principles influence artistic creation and how beauty guides scientific discovery, presented by a U-M Physics and Engineering professor.
events.imageAlt: Saturday Morning Physics | The Physics of Art and the Art of Physics
events.experienceId: experience:["ann arbor","weiser hall","saturday morning physics the physics of art and the art of physics"]

evidence.description: Moving from light and color through Helmholtz’s science of perception, this talk traces the remarkable journey from physical reality to what the eye sees, what the artist creates, and what the audience imagines—while discussing the physics principles behind it. It then turns the lens around to ask how beauty, elegance, and symmetry guide physicists in their search for the laws of nature.
